selected_evidence.summary: Shows the persistent helpdesk account, password set, home directory, and membership only in its own group.

selected_evidence.requirement: Allow helpdesk to restart the SSH service with sudo
selected_evidence.summary: The policy parses successfully. Actual restarts executed as UID 1000 returned zero, changed sshd PID/InvocationID, and preserved a successful SSH handshake to the managed IP before and after reboot.
Effective sudo policy lists only SSH restart. Authenticated attempts to run root id, stop SSH, restart crond, and open a root shell were all explicitly denied.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID a1be807a-f931-4328-b608-cd61f894ed55, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 892360ba-9939-4d17-bf48-56a16004a484, recovered system/SSH health, persisted account and identical sudoers checksum, and a successful post-reboot helpdesk SSH restart.
